newsitem.title: USA: ContiFinancial files for 2.8 mln shr offer.
newsitem.headline: ContiFinancial files for 2.8 mln shr offer.

text.p: ContiFinancial Corp said Monday that it had filed a registration statement for 2.8 million shares of its common stock owned by its majority owner, Continental Grain Co.

The shares of ContiFinancial common stock being registered are related to a planned offering of Structured Yield Product Exchangeable for Stock of Merrill Lynch & Co Inc for the benefit of Continental Grain.

The STRYPES will be exchangeable in three years for shares of ContiFinancial or cash. If Continental Grain Co chooses to deliver ContiFinancial shares, its ownership of ContiFinancial would be reduced from about 75 percent to about 70 percent, excluding the exercise of an overallotment option on the STRYPES offering, ContiFinancial said.
ContiFinancial said Continental Grain wants to use the STRYPES structure as part of its overall financial planning. The convertible debt issuance will be underwritten by Merrill Lynch & Co.
ContiFinancial said it will not receive any proceeds from the shares offered.
ContiFinancial is a consumer and commercial finance company headquartered in New York City.
